one
two
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "one"

Explanation:
☛ "One" is correct here because the sentence uses the superlative adjective "most fundamental", which pairs with a singular noun.
☛ The phrase "Language is one of the most fundamental aspects..." follows the fixed structure "one of + plural noun", indicating a single item from a group.
☛ Other options (three, four, two) are illogical as they disrupt the sentence's meaning and grammatical flow.
☛ Parts of Speech: "One" functions as a pronoun here, selecting a single item from the plural noun "aspects".

Exam Tip: Recognize the pattern "One of the + superlative adjective + plural noun" and always choose "one" for such blanks.
